text:
Against the background of a warm summer evening, where the sky is gradually turning into deep shades of indigo, two young men are standing next to a shiny motorcycle. The motorcycle is a real star of the scene: its chrome details reflect the last rays of the sunset, and the black paint of the body shimmers with a light velvety sheen. In the background, you can see an endless field, swaying slightly in a light breeze, and on the horizon the first stars are already starting to light up, like tiny lights winking at the earth.
The guys are facing each other, their shadows lengthening on the asphalt. One of them, in a leather jacket with the sleeves rolled up, is gesturing, his face expressing slight irritation. The second one, in a plain white T-shirt and jeans, listens calmly, but there is confidence in his eyes. Their argument seems to be about something important- maybe about the route of tomorrow's trip or who will be driving. There is an atmosphere of youthful excitement and freedom around them.
The sky stretched above them, gradually darkening, but still retaining the remnants of the orange and pink shades of sunset. The first stars are already beginning to appear, like thin silver dots scattered across the velvet fabric of the sky. Somewhere in the distance, a light hum of the evening wind can be heard, and silence reigns around, broken only by their voices.
This picture is like a frozen moment, full of energy, youth and romance of the roads.
